comparison.objective: Fit and center a gasket between pipe flanges and insert four bolts; unlike separating finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-part insertion into a constrained flange gap and repeated bolt alignment versus controlled pouring, agitation, and selective screen passage.
comparison.success_condition: Full score requires a centered gasket, four seated bolts, unchanged upper flange, release, and dwell; candidate requires complete feed, at least 98% media recovery, total washer retention, and no spill. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Both involve apertures and alignment, but the tested abilities are constrained assembly versus bulk physical separation.
